title: Retail Sales Performance Report (2023-2024)
executive_summary: The business generated $445,325.09 in total revenue across 520 orders in 2023-2024. Year-over-year revenue increased by 10.08%. The East region led regional performance, and 2024 quarterly revenue peaked in Q3. High-discount electronics orders contributed $50,035.33, while revenue distribution was skewed by a few high-value transactions.

key_findings.statement: Total revenue for the period was $445,325.09 from 520 orders, resulting in an average order value of $856.39.
Revenue varied by region, with the East region generating $130,516.69 and the South region generating $90,534.49.
In 2024, quarterly revenue increased from $36,108.31 in Q1 to a peak of $71,674.99 in Q3, before settling at $68,948.71 in Q4.
Revenue increased from $211,976.29 in 2023 to $233,348.80 in 2024, representing a year-over-year increase of 10.08%.
There were 22 high-discount electronics orders (discount >= 20%), contributing $50,035.33 to total revenue.
Order revenue distribution was right-skewed: the mean was $856.39 while the median was $313.28, with a sample standard deviation of $1,295.74. Values ranged from $5.27 to $7,844.02.
The business served 222 unique customers. The top customer contributed $27,793.13 in revenue, accounting for 6.24% of the total.

limitations: The analysis assumes the cleaned dataset is complete for the 2023-2024 period; unexported or deleted orders are not represented.
Customer concentration analysis relies on customer_id and does not account for potential duplicate identities or corporate hierarchies.
conclusion: The business shows healthy growth with a 10% year-over-year revenue increase. Regional performance is strongest in the East. The significant gap between mean and median order revenue indicates reliance on a subset of high-value orders, a risk also reflected in the top customer share. Monitoring the high-discount electronics segment is recommended given its 11% revenue contribution.
